title: Fex Components Configuration
description: Configuration schema for Fex CLI components.json

$schema.description: Relative path to the local offline schema.json or schema URI

framework.description: Target UI framework used by this project

tailwind.description: Tailwind CSS configuration and entry file

css.description: Path to the main CSS stylesheet containing Tailwind directives

baseColor.description: Base color palette for design tokens (e.g. neutral, slate)

aliases.description: Import aliases and target directory mappings for components, hooks, and utils

components.description: Root alias or path for all components (e.g. @/components or @pkg/ui/components)

pro.description: Alias for enterprise pro composite components (e.g. @/components/pro)

utils.description: Alias for utility functions and shared controllers (e.g. @/lib/utils or @pkg/utils)

lib.description: Optional root alias for library utilities (e.g. @/lib)
